rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user or verify ownership of the order(s), did not confirm with the user before performing an order-changing action, and appears to have canceled an entire order (#W1845024) despite the user’s preference to keep hiking items if partial cancellation was possible. The agent also provided a specific refund amount ($1,527.24), payment method (PayPal), and timeline without showing any supporting tool calls or results. No evidence of checking which items were office vs. hiking or whether partial cancellation was possible. These constitute unsupported statements and policy violations, so the request was not completed in line with the policy.
